meta.parties: Hadjiar Et Al. v. Don Et Al

rules.statement: An action for damages consequent on judicial eviction is maintainable against all previous vendors where there is privity of contract between the plaintiff and all defendants due to a covenant to warrant and defend the title.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held, that the action was maintainable against all the defendants, as there was privity of contract between the plaintiff and all the defendants."
